title: Data centers lose at ballot box
content: Voters expressed their feelings on data centers on Tuesday via ballot measures restricting their development. That rejection comes as public opposition to data centers and fear of AI continues to rise, notes New Street Research.

title: Supermicro taps SambaNova to power AI inference racks alongside Nvidia
content: Supermicro will work with SambaNova to develop leading-edge SN50 inference racks that operate alongside NVIDIA GPUs as part of Supermicro’s Data Center Building Block Solutions.
